Card name and concept: 菜 / Noob — a self-deprecating novice defensive skill that accepts 1 Weak to gain a large amount of Block. The same young adult male swordsman has short tousled ash-blond hair, amber eyes, a cobalt-blue hood and flowing scarf, fitted layered black clothing and black gloves. He makes an awkward protective crouch behind an oversized glowing golden shield, with his sword held uncertainly low. One tiny harmless practice projectile is bouncing off the enormous shield, and a subtle purple ribbon of weakness curls around his wrist. His eyes convey embarrassed determination, a gently humorous rookie moment rather than swagger. Match the existing sharp Japanese-anime fantasy painterly style: vivid cobalt blue and warm amber gold, deep black textured shadows, bold angular brushwork, dramatic golden rim light. One clear readable action, anatomically coherent human with exactly two arms and two hands, five fingers per visible hand. Keep important face, hands and shield within the central 85 percent of the frame. Opaque painted environment fills every edge. No title, text, letters, digits, logo, watermark, UI, border, multiple panels or collage. Deliver one finished 1000x790 PNG.
